card.name: Start of words like consume, conceal, concomitant
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word beginning with con-, conce-, uncon- or occ-, most often at the start of a sentence or heading. Typical words are Consume, Concomitant, concealing and occulta.

modes.label: Sentence-initial Consume
modes.description: "Con" starts the word Consume at the start of an instruction sentence about taking a mixture.
modes.example: Administer the dose.<< Con>>sume the entire mixture immediately.

modes.label: Concomitant in headings
modes.description: "Con" starts Concomitant in a warnings section heading or risk phrase.

modes.label: Conceal and hidden-sense words
modes.description: The first piece of conceal, concealing or unconsciously, or of occulta, meaning hidden.
modes.example: concerns with holding the pump in place and<< conce>>aling it under clothing.

card.writes: It promotes pieces like "oc" and suppresses "hidden" words, so it favors continuing into words that begin with oc- or con-.
card.plain: It fires on the first piece of words like consume, concomitant and conceal, before the rest of the word is written.
